get.description:
List every API key across all caches owned by the calling account.
The account is derived from the JWT claims; no path or query parameters
are accepted. The response is not paginated.

consent.description:
User consent for accuracy analyzer data collection.
Required when enabling for the first time (transitioning from NOT_CONFIGURED).

AccuracyAnalyzerState.description:
Accuracy analyzer state
The state of the accuracy analyzer.
- ENABLED: The accuracy analyzer is enabled and active for the cache.
- DISABLED: The accuracy analyzer is explicitly disabled for the cache, having been enabled prior to that.
- NOT_CONFIGURED: The accuracy analyzer has never been configured for the cache. The is the default initial state.
